description: The OTHER batch on the name search's hits: C00558-7, the Church of St. Michael and All Angels register for the same parish (19,206 records). CAPTURED LIVE 2026-08-13, trimmed only by dropping each row's `gedcomx`. Stocked because the paired name-search fixture surfaces TWO Ashton batches and C00558-7 is the more specifically named of the pair — a skill that reasons well can defensibly pick either. Without this fixture the test would grade on guessing which batch happened to be stocked: the judge context calls that choice acceptable, and it would have dead-ended on fixture_not_found. hasMore true against 19,206 makes the same paging point as its sibling.
